from collections import deque
from pathlib import Path

program = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and grid[ny][nx]!=0 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            comps.append(cells)
    comps.sort(key=len, reverse=True)
    objs=[]
    for cells in comps[:2]:
        r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)+1
        c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)+1
        objs.append((r0,r1,c0,c1))
    objs.sort()
    (a0,a1,ac0,ac1),(b0,b1,bc0,bc1)=objs
    hh=min(a1-a0,b1-b0); ww=min(ac1-ac0,bc1-bc0)
    # center-crop if dimensions differ, then compare aligned rows
    aa=(ac1-ac0-ww)//2; bb=(bc1-bc0-ww)//2
    rows=[]
    for i in range(hh):
        row=[8 if grid[a0+i][ac0+aa+j] != grid[b0+i][bc0+bb+j] else 0 for j in range(ww)]
        if any(row): rows.append(row)
    return rows
'''
program_path=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486017/attempts/44ff304bb01845389149adac5e6f0a25/system/state/workspace/programs/task-b6982c7a.py')
program_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path.write_text(program)
exec(program, globals())
